How you ship with INK

Pick the operating model. The deployment surface, workspace boundaries, and agent entry points stay in one place.

For developers

Push code. Or let your agent push it.

Either way, live in under a minute. No infra to touch.

Push to INK git or GitHub, or let your agent do it through the CLI, Skills, or MCP. INK takes the build from there: stack detected, service deployed, logs and metrics available, billed only while it runs.

Your services

Deploy. Monitor. Ship.

Create services from GitHub repos or Docker images, then watch them come alive with real-time metrics and logs.

Create from source

GitHub repo or Docker image becomes a running service.

Inspect runtime state

The same surface exposes health, metrics, and logs.

Templates & Databases

One click. Or one prompt.

Deploy databases and full-stack templates from the canvas, or let your agent do it autonomously through the CLI or MCP.

Stateful services

Databases and persistent storage live beside app services.

Repeatable starts

Templates turn common stacks into a deployable starting point.

Observability

See everything. So can your agent.

Real-time metrics and structured logs, accessible from the dashboard or programmatically through the CLI, Skills, and MCP.

Human dashboard

Filter logs, inspect charts, and find runtime issues visually.

Pay for what you use

No idle charges. You only pay per minute while your services are running. Your agent controls CPU and memory allocation and can adjust resources in real time.

Universal deployment

Deploy any stack

From static sites to full-stack apps, your agent deploys whatever it builds. No config files, no Docker setup, no CI pipelines, just code and go.

Docker, buildpacks, or auto-detected. Use one deploy surface across runtimes instead of choosing a different platform per stack.
